title: KalshiPaperSim — Paper-Trading Competition Lab
description: Paper-trading lab for 61 strategies on Kalshi markets — deliberately separate from the live paper-trading competition — whose counter pipeline fills a history store from Kalshi's public API on GitHub Actions, regenerates the browser-safe modules, leaderboard, charts and docs, and commits the result. Everything below was re-derived at head 8a359bd (2026-09-23T22:56:42Z) from the repository's own committed files rather than from its prose. Executed there: node --test test/*.test.js → 157 tests, 157 pass, 0 fail, and require('./src/strategies.js') → 61 strategies. Loaded and summed there: data/reports/candle-coverage.json holds 122 markets totalling 13,228 stored daily bars, of which 13,092 were added by the ingest; its flight report ranks the daily replay as 31 entries over 401 periods across those 122 markets, of which 7 finished ahead of the 100,000 starting capital (best MakerFlip_SpreadHarvest +3.69%), 19 behind (worst GammaWhale_Squeeze -38.22%) and 5 flat, while the hourly flight runs 1,568 periods over 418 markets; and live-desk.json records 23 desk entrants on a 100-market tradeable universe with 32 orders, 31 paper fills, 1 cancel, 0 rejects and 2,347.59448 of official fees. The repository's own VERIFICATION.md itemises 125 verified facts, 110 of which carry a URL a reader can open, and IRREGULARITIES.md holds 67 flagged headings. data/reports/game-window-captures.json, generated 2026-09-23T20:00:27Z, classifies 2,307 captured ladders across 222 stores and reports 2 captured inside a verified event window in series KXMLBGAME, 1,199 further non-empty ladders inside the tradeable window whose event window could not be joined, and 1,106 post-close — its own honestNote states both figures rather than only the flattering one.

The README's AUTO:COUNTS banner also still says 13,341 candles, 149 tests and $2,719.9854 of fees where the committed artifacts and the executed suite give 13,228, 157 and $2,347.59448.

The Python pipeline this entry previously described no longer exists. At head 8a359bd `find . -name '*.py'` returns nothing, scripts/verify.py and scripts/trade.py are absent, there is no `*/30 * * * *` cron in any of the nine workflow files, and scripts/verify.py's 'five PASS / 47 FAIL public-figure gates' figure cannot be reproduced because the script that printed it is gone. The pipeline is now Node (scripts/render-docs.js, run-reports.mjs, ingest-history.mjs, verify-game-window.mjs) gated by ci.yml, which runs npm test, test/workflow-race-guard.sh, npm run test:ui and node build.js.

Its headline counters are machine-regenerated and move on nearly every commit, so any quoted figure has a short shelf life; this entry's figures are stamped to head 8a359bd and the counters in AUTO:COUNTS were already ahead of the artifacts they summarise.

Figures withdrawn this pass because they are not re-derivable from the current tree: the previous entry's hourly-store totals (436 markets / 53 series / 282 finalized / 23,522 closes), micro-store totals (421 / 47 / 283 / 13,347) and the 19-template / 24-code-driven / 18-synthetic strategies breakdown. None of the three appears in README.md at head and no committed summary block could be located for them, so they are removed rather than restated.

Paper trading only, on captured data: no order is ever submitted to Kalshi. The Live Desk trades real OPEN contracts priced from captured ladders, but fills are simulated and the replay flights are historical, so a strategy's rank here is not a claim about live execution. Its leaderboard table also excludes at least one design entirely rather than showing it at 0 percent.
